name: preview-vision
description: Does seeing help? Three web tasks whose visible suites always pass (verify true) and whose real grading is behavioral contract graders measuring the RENDERED page (geometry, computed colors, error-free load). Arms: no preview at all; blind preview (runtime errors + blank-page check, no vision); full preview with the vision model describing a screenshot. All arms get grounding so the only variable is eyes. Judge on contract pass rate, autoPreviews, turns.

arms.name: baseline
arms.description: No preview surface at all — today's blind-build behavior.

arms.name: blind
arms.description: Preview + auto-preview, but no vision: errors, failed loads, blank-page check only.

arms.name: vision
arms.description: Full preview: errors plus the vision model's description of the screenshot.
